atoms.text: Hi everyone! What are you all doing today for the school newspaper?
Fatima and I want to write opinion pieces on the topic of homework. Our aim is to make our arguments clear and concise, without repeating the same points again and again.
I’m going to interview our football coach, Jordan. I’ll ask him some questions and get his opinion on today’s match. It would be great if someone could take some pictures too.
I can help with that Mohammed! I can take some team photos and get some cool action shots too.
Great ideas everyone! I will edit the work and make sure it is polished so that it is ready for printing by the end of the week.
